Regarding the sentence provided, the phrase "every day in the week" is redundant and awkwardly placed. Here are a few clearer and more precise adjustments:

1.  **He almost drove his colleagues to work every day of the week.** (Simplest correction)
2.  **He almost drove his colleagues to work daily throughout the week.** (More formal)
3.  **He almost drove his colleagues to work every single day.** (Emphasizes frequency)
